newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Associates First raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Associates First raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Monday it had raised its rating for Associates First Capital Inc to outperform from outperform (long term), based on Gruntal's anticipation of a strong quarter and a recent decline in the stock price.
-- Gruntal said its price target is $55.

-- Associates First shares have been under severe pressure recently, falling 15 percent in the last three weeks, Gruntal said. The shares apparently found a floor last week, which provides an excellent opportunity to buy, Gruntal said.
-- Associates First is a commercial and consumer finance organization.
